existing_tips: Mildly vulgar but extremely common in casual Swedish.
Adjective fronting for emphasis: adjective + som + subject + verb.
"Hår" is ett-word: "det röda håret" – double definite with adjective.
Double definite with en-word: den + svarta + katten. Adjective always ends in -a in definite.
"Dofta" = smell (emit scent). "Gott" (neuter) here because it's an adverb, not adjective.
